description: Create 8 reusable form components in Frontend/src/components/form/ with WCAG AA accessibility, RTL support, and Tailwind design tokens. Components: TextInput (text, email, tel, url, password with validation), TextArea (auto-resize, character count), Select (with keyboard navigation and searchable option), PhoneInput (Sudan +249 prefix, format validation), PriceInput (currency selector, thousand separators, SDG default), DatePicker (native input wrapper), FileUpload (drag-drop, progress, multi-file), and barrel index export.
steps: Create Frontend/src/components/form/TextInput.tsx: component with props (id, name, label, value, onChange, placeholder, error, helperText, disabled, required, type, maxLength, showCount); handle states (default, focus ring-primary-200, error border-error-500, disabled opacity-50); RTL logical padding (ps-); ARIA (aria-invalid, aria-describedby, aria-required); design: rounded-xl, border-sand-200, focus:ring-primary-100
Create Frontend/src/components/form/TextArea.tsx: same props/states as TextInput plus rows, autoResize; implement onInput listener to auto-adjust height; display character count

Create Frontend/src/components/form/Select.tsx: props (id, name, label, value, onChange, options, placeholder, error, disabled, required, searchable); RTL arrow flip via scale-x-[-1]; keyboard support (arrows, Enter, Esc); ARIA (role='listbox', aria-selected); render <select> for non-searchable, custom dropdown for searchable

Create Frontend/src/components/form/PhoneInput.tsx: props (value, onChange, error, label, disabled, required); fixed '+249' prefix in read-only box on start; format on blur (+249 XX XXX XXXX); validate /^(09|01)[0-9]{8}$/; RTL logical layout

Create Frontend/src/components/form/PriceInput.tsx: props (value, onChange, currency default SDG, onCurrencyChange, min, max, error, label, disabled); thousand separators via toLocaleString; inline currency selector dropdown

Create Frontend/src/components/form/DatePicker.tsx: props (value ISO string, onChange, label, error, disabled, required, min, max); use native <input type='date'> wrapped with MARBOU styling; add comment about future Hijri support

Create Frontend/src/components/form/FileUpload.tsx: props (onUpload, maxFiles default 10, maxSizeMB default 5, accept default 'image/*', files UploadFile[], onRemove); define UploadFile type (id, file, preview, progress, error?, status); UI: drag-drop zone + click; per-file: thumbnail, progress bar, error, remove button; drag state: dashed border primary-300, bg-primary-50
Create Frontend/src/components/form/index.ts: barrel export for all 7 components
Ensure all components use TypeScript strict, zero 'any', design tokens only, React.memo where appropriate
acceptance_criteria: All 7 form components created and compile without errors
TextInput supports type, maxLength, showCount, validation, error states, disabled state, ARIA labels
TextArea auto-resizes, displays character count, supports same states as TextInput
Select supports keyboard navigation (arrows, Enter, Esc), searchable option, ARIA role and attributes
PhoneInput validates Sudanese mobile (+249 format), shows fixed prefix, formats on blur
PriceInput shows thousand separators, supports currency selector, defaults to SDG
DatePicker uses native input type='date', wraps with Tailwind styling
FileUpload supports drag-drop, multi-file, progress tracking, per-file error handling
All components have proper RTL logical padding/placement (ps-, pe-, start, end)
4.5:1 contrast ratio maintained for all text
44px minimum touch target size for buttons/inputs
npm run typecheck passes with zero errors
verification: Import all components: verify imports work via 'import { TextInput, Select, ... } from @/components/form'
npm run build — includes all form components
Manually render each component in dev server and verify styling, states, RTL behavior
